system.description:
Very powerful, firing a large number of bullets very quickly - the favorite weapon of many gangs. Sold as non-automatic (single-shot only) by law, but the Repair Ability can convert one to fully automatic fire.

Negative Traits: Loud

Concealability: Jacket

Damage: Two health levels

Availability: Any, if registered and non-automatic; Police 4, Street 4, or Underworld 3 otherwise.

Special Abilities: Spray (up to five targets standing immediately next to each other, further than 10 feet from the shooter); Fully Automatic (an additional health level of damage if the entire clip is emptied into a target within five feet).
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama
